## Performance Details

### Timing Information
If you can measure timing:
- **Expected performance**: [e.g. "Screen should load in under 1 second"]
- **Actual performance**: [e.g. "Takes 5-8 seconds to load"]
- **Measurement method**: [e.g. "Stopwatch", "Developer tools", "Visual observation"]

### Resource Usage
If you can observe resource usage:
- **Memory usage**: [e.g. "App uses 500MB+", "Memory keeps increasing"]
- **CPU usage**: [e.g. "High CPU during scrolling", "CPU spikes when loading data"]
- **Battery impact**: [e.g. "App drains 20% battery in 1 hour", "Device gets very hot"]

## Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the performance issue:
1. Go to '...'
2. Perform action '....'
3. Observe slow/laggy behavior
4. Note timing or resource usage
